sintra.title: Sintra Mysteries
sintra.description: The real Palácio da Pena route, through viewpoints, memorials and the hidden paths of the Sintra hills.

castelo.title: Castle Walls
castelo.description: Walk the real trails around the Castelo dos Mouros, the 8th-century Moorish fortress that has watched over the hills for more than a thousand years.

arrabida.title: Arrábida Secrets
arrabida.description: The real climb to Alto do Formosinho, the highest point of the Arrábida hills, among cliffs, springs and deep blue sea.

portinho.title: Portinho Coast
portinho.description: A real coastal trail around Portinho da Arrábida, past the 16th-century Franciscan convent, Forte de Santa Maria and hidden beaches.

monsanto.title: Monsanto Lookout
monsanto.description: The real loop around Monsanto's plateau, Lisbon's green lung, among viewpoints, granite boulders and stories of the city.

agua.title: Water Ways
agua.description: Monsanto's real Water Route: springs, tanks and the paths that followed the water that supplied Lisbon since the Águas Livres Aqueduct.
